in_marathi.name: Ayushmann
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayushmann हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayushmann is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ayus’ meaning ‘life’ and ‘man’ meaning ‘man’. This name is often given to a child in the hope that he will lead a long and healthy life.
